developer: Bangladesh Agriculture Research Institute (BARI), Gazipur, Bangladesh
main_characteristics: Plant height medium; intermediate type; canopy habit determinate; growth habit semi-erect; absent or very few branching; thickness of main stem medium; extension of anthocyanin coloration of stem very strong. Tuber shape long oval; tuber size large; depth of eyes shallow; smoothness of tuber skin smooth; color of tuber skin pink red; color of base of eye red; color of flesh white; eye distribution even; uniformity of tuber medium. crop duration 80-85 days.
source_org: BARI, via BSMRAU Digital Herbarium of Crop Plants
